note: The exports the readers in lib/readers.js tell apart by header row. 'verified' says how the column names were checked: 'docs' = read on the service's public documentation that day; 'community' = only in public community posts, not the service's own docs; 'memory' = from known real exports, not found in public docs; the readers match loosely so close variants still work.

exports.label: Stripe payments
exports.how: In Stripe: Payments, set the dates, Export, keep the default columns.
exports.identify: Columns id, Created date (UTC), Amount, Amount Refunded, Fee, Status
exports.uses: Created date (UTC), Amount (or Converted Amount), Amount Refunded, Refunded date (UTC), Fee, Status, Captured, Description, Disputed Amount, Dispute Date (UTC), Dispute Evidence Due (UTC), Dispute Reason, Dispute Status
exports.source: https://support.stripe.com/questions/exporting-payment-data (says columns are chosen at export; does not list them)

exports.label: Stripe balance activity
exports.how: In Stripe: Reports, Balance summary, Balance change from activity, Export, CSV, Itemized.
exports.identify: Columns balance_transaction_id, created, gross, fee, net, reporting_category (or the older Type, Amount, Fee, Net, Available On)
exports.uses: created (or created_utc), gross, fee, net, reporting_category (charge, refund, dispute, dispute_reversal, fee, payout), description

exports.label: Shopify orders
exports.how: In Shopify admin: Orders, Export, pick the dates, CSV for Excel, Numbers or other spreadsheet programs.
exports.identify: Columns Name, Financial Status, Total, Created at, Lineitem name
exports.uses: Name, Financial Status, Created at (or Paid at), Total, Refunded Amount, Lineitem quantity, Lineitem name, Lineitem price, Lineitem discount

exports.label: Square transactions
exports.how: In Square Dashboard: Transactions, set the dates, Export, Transactions CSV.
exports.identify: Columns Date, Time, Gross Sales, Net Sales, Total Collected, Fees, Event Type, Transaction ID
exports.uses: Date, Time, Total Collected (or Gross Sales), Partial Refunds, Fees, Event Type (Payment or Refund), Transaction ID, Description
exports.source: Square Seller Community posts listing the Transactions CSV headers (sellercommunity.com, community.squareup.com); Square's help center does not list them

exports.label: PayPal activity
exports.how: In PayPal: Activity, Statements, Activity report (Download), CSV, all transactions.
exports.identify: Columns Date, Time, TimeZone, Name, Type, Status, Gross, Fee, Net, Transaction ID
exports.uses: Date, Time, Type, Status, Gross (or Amount), Fee, Transaction ID, Item Title
exports.source: https://developer.paypal.com/docs/reports/online-reports/activity-download/ (fields described; exact CSV header names vary by account)

exports.label: Meta ads
exports.how: In Meta Ads Manager: pick Campaigns or Ads, set the dates, Breakdown, By time, Day, then Reports, Export table data, CSV.
exports.identify: Columns Campaign name (or Ad name), Amount spent (USD), Impressions, Results
exports.uses: Day (or Reporting starts and Reporting ends), Campaign name, Ad name, Amount spent, Impressions, Link clicks, Results, Result indicator, Purchases conversion value
exports.source: Ads Manager export column names; Meta's help center does not list them

exports.label: Google Ads
exports.how: In Google Ads: Campaigns, Segment, Time, Day, then Download, CSV.
exports.identify: A title line and a date range, then columns Campaign, Impr., Clicks, Cost, Conversions
exports.uses: Day, Campaign, Ad group, Cost, Impr., Clicks, Conversions, Conv. value. Total rows are skipped.
exports.source: Google Ads report download format; column names follow the Google Ads interface

exports.label: Instagram posts
exports.how: In Meta Business Suite: Insights, Content, set the dates, Export data, Posts, CSV.
exports.identify: Columns Post ID, Account username, Description, Publish time, Permalink, Post type
exports.uses: Publish time, Description, Permalink, Post type, Views (or Impressions or Reach), Reach, Likes, Comments, Shares, Saves, Follows
exports.source: Meta Business Suite content export; Meta renamed Impressions to Views in 2025 and the reader takes either

exports.label: TikTok posts
exports.how: In TikTok Studio: Analytics, Content, Download data (save it as CSV if it comes as a spreadsheet).
exports.identify: Columns Video title, Video link, Post time, Total views
exports.uses: Post time, Video title, Video link, Total views, Total likes, Total comments, Total shares
exports.source: TikTok analytics download; TikTok's help center does not list the columns

exports.label: Post stats
exports.how: Any sheet with one row per post: the date, the caption and the views, likes, comments, shares and saves.
exports.identify: A date column, a caption column and views or likes
exports.uses: The same as the Instagram export

exports.label: Your numbers sheet
exports.how: Three columns: date, metric, value. One row per number per day, like 2026-10-19, Calls booked, 4. Costs (Supplies, Rent, Booth fee) count as cash out; running totals (Followers, Bank balance) take the newest value.

exports.label: Your daily sheet
exports.how: A date column first, then one column per number: Date, Calls booked, Email signups.

skill.how: In Claude: Customize, Skills, the plus button, Create skill, Upload a skill, then pick the ZIP. Skills need code execution turned on in Claude's settings.
skill.rules: The ZIP holds one folder named like the skill; SKILL.md starts with a name (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters, matching the folder) and a description (at most 200 characters on Claude.ai).
